title: Evolutionary Biology
description: Evolutionary biology explains how genetic variation, selection, drift, history, and ecology shape biological diversity. The syllabus combines population genetics, adaptation, speciation, phylogenetics, macroevolution, molecular evolution, and applied evolutionary thinking.
